notes: Spec: AN, max 22 bytes (13 for Table/Phone/Date-Time/Software Load requests). Composite: Device Type(2)+State Code(2)+Merchant Number(6-15)+Device Number(3). CSV heuristic wrongly locked this to the exact 13-char values observed in sample data.
Spec also allows DL1-DL6 (Data Link segments); not included here since those are not plain numeric segment-type values.
Spec: N, 3 or 4 bytes depending on segment.
Spec: AN 1 byte. '?'=download, 0=single-message, 1=multimessage.
Spec: N, up to 8 bytes variable, 2 assumed decimals.
Spec: N, up to 8 bytes (7 max for non-Amex), 2 assumed decimals.
Spec: N, up to 8 bytes (7 max for non-Amex), 2 assumed decimals.
Spec: N, up to 8 bytes (7 max for non-Amex), 2 assumed decimals.
Spec: N, 6 bytes. Valid ranges 000001-999999 (normal) or 100000-199999 (multithreaded); range itself not enforced here, only shape.
Spec: ANS, 24-425 bytes, varies by TransArmor mode/track data rules - too variable to safely pattern-match; left unchecked.
Spec: AN, 6 bytes, space-filled. Empty on the initial Financial Request; populated on Completion/response once approved.
Spec: N, 2 bytes, 01-10.
Spec: N, 1 byte. 0=not supported (default), 1=supported, 5=balance receipt only (Amex prepaid).
Spec: AN, fixed 36 bytes (16-20 byte KSN + 16-byte PIN block). Empty when the transaction carries no PIN (e.g. credit, no debit/EBT PIN entry).
Raw magnetic-stripe/EMV track 1 or 2 data (part of Element 2, Account Number). Too variable in length/format (PAN + separators + expiry + discretionary data) to safely pattern-match.
Spec: N, up to 12 bytes, 2 assumed decimals.
Spec: N, fixed 3 digits. Full enum lives in Appendix F, not yet fully transcribed in this KB, so only the 3-digit shape is enforced.
Spec: N, up to 9 bytes, up to 3 assumed decimal places.
Spec: A, 1 byte. 0-9 reserved for private use.
Spec: N, up to 9 bytes, up to 3 assumed decimal places.
Spec: Appendix G, Valid Transaction Type Codes (position 1 of 3-4 char Prompt Code, Element 78).
Spec: N, up to 2 bytes variable, 1-99. Real sample data zero-pads (e.g. '05'). Empty on non-fuel/non-pump transactions.

Spec: AN, fixed 10 bytes, left-justified space-filled.
Spec: A, 1 byte. 0-9 reserved for private use.
Spec: AN, 1 byte. D=Dual message/credit, S=Single message/debit, X=Dual/non-traditional Signature Debit.
Spec: AN, 1 byte. T=required, F=not required, space=device software logic determines (represented here as empty).
Spec: N, fixed length 25 bytes.

Spec: AN, fixed 3 bytes, right-aligned zero-padded (000-099) per the spec text, but real sample data sends it without zero-padding (e.g. '25'), so 1-3 digits is accepted; or 3 spaces if EMV Tag 5F34 absent (represented here as empty).
Spec: N, fixed 3 digits, 000-999.
Spec: ANSB, up to 999 bytes of TLV-encoded binary EMV data - not representable as a simple pattern.
Spec: ANSB, up to 984 bytes; layout depends on Appendix T Table ID - too variable to pattern-match generically.
Spec: N, fixed 10 bytes, MMDDYYHHMM.
Spec: AN, up to 100 bytes in <tag><len><data> format - too variable to pattern-match generically.
